title: Book Checked Out
description: The book you want is already borrowed by someone else
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Какую книгу вы ищете?
systemPrompt: You are a librarian. The book 'Война и мир' is checked out. Returns in 2 weeks. Can reserve it. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User asked for book, learned it's unavailable, and reserved it or chose another.
hints: Мне нужна книга (I need a book)
Когда она вернётся? (When will it return?)
